description: GET /v1/profiles as Wingman sees it: every profile is listed, allowed says which this client may ask for, available says which the Mac can run yet. A host profile (runs: host) is never allowed for Wingman, even when its scope names it (coding-v1). Clients grey out profiles that are not allowed or not available and never send them. digest is sha256:<hex> of the resolved manifest; compare it, do not parse it.
